**Purpose.** Aggregate single-nucleus profiles into mean log-count pseudobulk profiles per cell type and individual with muscat, record each gene's capture rate, and remove outlier samples by excitatory-neuron fraction.

**Inputs.** `combinedCells_ACTIONet`, `ACTIONet_summary` (datasets/), `individual_metadata` (tables/rds).

**Outputs.** `pseudobulk_mean_logcounts` and `pseudobulk_mean_logcounts_filtered` (datasets/); capture-rate density plot (figures/).

**Paper item.** Input to the differential expression analysis (Methods).

**Run notes.** Loads the full ACTIONet object; memory heavy. Paths come from `config/paths.R` (see `docs/data.md`). Chunks are not evaluated by default; set `eval = TRUE` in the setup chunk to run.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Shared configuration: data paths and helper functions.
source(here::here("config", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ACTIONet)
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(cowplot)
  library(corrplot)
  library(muscat)
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = FALSE,
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  dev = c("png", "pdf"),
  tidy = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
individual_metadata = loadDataset("individual_metadata", dataset.path = file.path(tables.path, "rds"))

ace = loadDataset("combinedCells_ACTIONet", dataset.path = dataset.path)
ACTIONet_summary = loadDataset("ACTIONet_summary", dataset.path = dataset.path)
```

# Convert it to SCE object
```{r}
sce = as(ace, "SingleCellExperiment")
```

# Use muscat to compute PB profiles
```{r}
sce$cluster_id = ace$Celltype
sce$group_id = ace$Phenotype
sce$sample_id = ace$ID

library(muscat)
sce$id <- paste0(sce$Phenotype, sce$sample_id)
(sce <- prepSCE(sce,
    kid = "cluster_id", # subpopulation assignments
    gid = "group_id",  # group IDs (ctrl/stim)
    sid = "sample_id",   # sample IDs (ctrl/stim.1234)
    drop = TRUE))  # drop all other colData columns

system.time( {pb.sce <- aggregateData(sce,
    assay = "logcounts", fun = "mean",
    by = c("cluster_id", "sample_id"))} )

colData(pb.sce) = cbind(colData(pb.sce), individual_metadata[colnames(pb.sce), ])
```

# Compute and add capture rate of genes (average number of cells that captured a gene)
```{r}
capture.rate = fastRowMeans(counts(ace) > 0)

require(ggpubr)
gg = ggdensity(data.frame(capture.rate), x = "capture.rate", fill = "lightgray")+ geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed")
storeFigure(gg, "capture_rate_density", figures.path = figures.path, extension = "pdf", width = 6, height = 4)

rowData(pb.sce)$capture.rate = capture.rate
```

# Store pseudobulk profiles
```{r}
storeDataset(pb.sce, name = "pseudobulk_mean_logcounts", dataset.path = dataset.path)
```

# Prefilter outlier samples using % of excitatory neurons
Samples whose excitatory-neuron fraction (excluding Ex-NRGN) falls outside 10% to 80% are removed: one with more than 80% and four with less than 10%, all from individuals with schizophrenia.
```{r}
filtered.samples = identify_outlier_samples(ACTIONet_summary$metadata)
pb.sce.filtered = pb.sce[, !(colnames(pb.sce) %in% filtered.samples)]
```

# Store filtered pseudobulk profiles
```{r}
storeDataset(pb.sce.filtered, name = "pseudobulk_mean_logcounts_filtered", dataset.path = dataset.path)
```
